head_coach.name: Hajime Moriyasu
head_coach.play_style_summary: Discipline-oriented, highly adaptable, and structured style focusing on compact defensive lines, coordinated high pressing to force turnovers, and rapid transitional counter-attacks balancing technical skill with physical intensity.

key_players.name: Takefusa Kubo
key_players.performance_stats: Core creative spark in the attacking third, vital in quick transitions and isolating defenders in one-on-one situations.

key_players.name: Hiroki Ito
key_players.performance_stats: Provides elite defensive stability and versatility, playing at the highest level in Europe with Bayern Munich.

key_players.name: Wataru Endo
key_players.performance_stats: The team captain and defensive anchor, crucial for breaking opponent lines and shielding the back four.
